meta.title: Savings account research — big national banks + national digital banks
meta.opened_on_note: Account-opening date used for every return projection on this site.
meta.scope: FDIC-insured national banks with a consumer savings account and a digital (app/online) channel. Retail-footprint banks were screened from the FDIC institution list by total assets; national online banks were added because they hold the highest verified savings APYs.

treasury_yields.source_note: Treasury yields as republished in the FDIC National Rates and Rate Caps table (October 2026).

products.apy_note: APY is ZIP-code gated: Chase's public rate page renders no table until a 5-digit ZIP is submitted, and states rates 'may vary by market'. No APY is recorded rather than inferred.
products.min_open_note: No minimum balance required to open (Chase FAQ).
products.fee_note: $5 monthly service fee; $0 with a $300+ balance at the beginning of each day, OR $25+ in Autosave/recurring transfers from a Chase checking account, OR a linked qualifying checking account, OR an owner under 25.
products.app: Yes — Chase Mobile® app (online check deposit, transfers, Autosave).
products.security: Data encryption; biometric login (Touch ID / Face ID / Android fingerprint or facial recognition); passkeys and password-manager support on chase.com; one-time code or app notification on new/unusual logins; 24/7 fraud monitoring; reimbursement commitment for unauthorized online/mobile transactions reported promptly.
products.fdic_note: FDIC insured up to the maximum amount allowed by law.
products.opening_rules: Apply online at chase.com or in a branch; SSN, address, email and contact details required (Chase FAQ).
flags: Chase does not publish a retrievable APY without a ZIP code; APY left blank (see Flagged for Review).

products.apy_note: APY is ZIP/location gated and not present in the served HTML. Not recorded.
products.min_open_note: The public page renders '$XXXX' placeholders for the monthly fee and fee-waiver balance, and does not state a minimum opening deposit in the served HTML.
products.fee_note: $XXXX placeholders on the public page; the fee-waiver conditions are listed (minimum daily balance, Advantage Relationship Banking, BofA Rewards Preferred Plus/Honors/Premier tier, or an owner under 25) but the dollar figures are injected client-side and could not be read.
products.app: Yes — Bank of America mobile app (App Store / Google Play links published on the product page).
products.security: Bank of America Security Center; additional controls are exposed only after login ('standard security already helps protect you… log in and take additional steps'), so specific MFA features could not be verified from a public page.
products.fdic_note: Deposit products are FDIC-insured (FDIC digital sign displayed on the product page).
products.opening_rules: Online application linked from the product page (Open now → Advantage Savings).
flags: APY not published in retrievable form (ZIP-gated).
Monthly fee and fee-waiver balance render as '$XXXX' placeholders — not recorded.

products.apy_note: Citi's savings APY pages return an empty shell to a non-JavaScript fetch; Citi's own disclosure states APY is 'determined by Rate Region, Relationship Tier and applicable promotion'. No single public APY exists to record.
products.fdic_note: Citibank, N.A. is an FDIC-insured institution (FDIC certificate 7213).
flags: Rate is region + relationship-tier + promotion dependent; no public APY retrievable.
Product, fee, app and security pages returned JavaScript-only shells in this pass — left blank.

products.apy_note: Standard interest rate 0.01% / APY 0.01% for balances of $0 or more (variable, compounded daily). The page shows no 'as of' date.
products.fee_note: $5 monthly service fee; waived with a $300 minimum daily balance, OR 1 automatic transfer of $25+ per fee period from a linked Wells Fargo checking account, OR 1 automatic transfer of $1+ each business day, OR 1+ Save As You Go transfers, OR primary owner 24 or under.
products.app: Yes — Wells Fargo Mobile® app (mobile deposit, transfers, in-app Security Center).
products.security: Zero-liability protection for promptly reported unauthorized card transactions; 24/7 fraud monitoring; Security Center with security tools and options.
products.fdic_note: Wells Fargo deposit accounts are FDIC-insured up to the maximum allowed by law.
products.opening_rules: Open online (18+) or at a branch; SSN, valid ID, current residential address and $25 opening deposit required. Minors 13+ as primary owner; 17 and under must open at a branch.
flags: Wells Fargo's page shows no effective/'as of' date for the 0.01% APY.

tiers.condition: Standard rate, no qualifying relationship account
Relationship rate, Combined Qualifying Balance under $5,000
Relationship rate, CQB $25,000+ (requires Smartly Checking, Safe Debit or Smartly Visa Signature)

products.apy_note: Standard APY 0.05%. Relationship tiers: 1.00% (CQB < $5,000), 2.00% ($5,000–$24,999.99), 3.50% ($25,000+). Effective 2026-10-21 for ZIP 55402; U.S. Bank states APYs may vary by location.
products.fee_note: $5 monthly maintenance fee, waivable when you are an account owner of eligible U.S. Bank accounts.
products.app: Yes — U.S. Bank Mobile App ('Get the mobile app' on the savings page).
products.security: Industry-standard encryption and zero fraud liability; Touch ID / Face ID (iOS) and fingerprint/face scan (Android) sign-in; card lock and unlock in the app; published digital security guarantee.
products.fdic_note: FDIC insured to the maximum allowed by law.
products.opening_rules: Open online; $25 minimum deposit. Relationship APY requires a Smartly Checking, Safe Debit or Smartly Visa Signature account plus the stated Combined Qualifying Balance.
flags: APYs may vary by location (bank's own statement); the rate sheet read is for ZIP 55402.

tiers.condition: As stated in the PNC page title; product availability is location-restricted

products.apy_note: 3.15% APY appears in the official PNC page title ('High Yield Savings Account | 3.15% Annual Percentage Yield APY'), but the page body returned 'This Product Isn't Available in Your Area' and no rate table or 'as of' date is served. Recorded as partial evidence only.
products.app: Yes — PNC Mobile Banking (App Store / Google Play badges published on PNC pages).
products.fdic_note: FDIC insured to the maximum permitted by law (PNC product pages).
flags: PNC's High Yield Savings page refused to render outside its service area (geo-gated); APY taken only from the page title and flagged partial.
Fee and minimum-opening values not verified.

products.apy_note: Every balance tier pays 0.01% rate / 0.01% APY. Truist states rates are accurate as of 2026-09-28.
products.fee_note: $5 monthly maintenance fee; waived with a $300 minimum daily ledger balance, OR a recurring internal transfer of $25+ per statement cycle, OR any related Truist checking account, OR an owner under 18. A $5 withdrawal-limit fee applies to each withdrawal over six per statement cycle.
products.withdrawal_note: First 6 withdrawals per statement cycle free; $5 per withdrawal after that (max 6 such fees per cycle).
products.app: Yes — Truist online and mobile banking (app QR code and mobile features listed on the product page).
products.opening_rules: Open online or in a branch; $50 minimum opening deposit.

products.apy_note: TD publishes savings APYs only after a location is selected; the served tables are empty and the page shows 'You are viewing info for .' with no location. Not recorded.
products.min_open_note: No minimum opening deposit, but the account closes automatically if no deposit is made within 45 days (TD FAQ).
products.fee_note: $15 monthly maintenance fee; waived with a $10,000 minimum daily balance or a linked eligible TD Beyond/Complete checking account. Tiered rates with a rate bump when an eligible TD account is linked.
products.app: Yes — TD Mobile Banking App (mobile deposit, Zelle, alerts; iOS and Android).
products.security: Touch ID sign-in plus a single-use security code (text or voice) at login; Security Center published; online security commitment.
products.fdic_note: TD savings accounts are FDIC-insured (TD product page).
products.opening_rules: Open online with SSN, government-issued ID, source-of-funds/existing banking information and a phone number (TD FAQ).
flags: APY is location-gated and not published in retrievable form.

products.apy_note: The official page states 'APY (Annual Percentage Yield) is variable and effective 10/21/2026' but the value renders as 'NaN APY' in the served HTML (client-side injection). Not recorded.
products.min_open_note: No minimum balance required to open or maintain; no fees to open or keep the account.
products.fee_note: No monthly fees and no minimums (Capital One product page).
products.withdrawal_note: Withdrawals online or at a branch; not by ATM directly (transfer to a checking account first).
products.app: Yes — Capital One Mobile app (mobile check deposit, AutoSave, card lock/unlock).
products.security: Facial recognition or fingerprint sign-in; two-step authentication; real-time fraud and purchase alerts; debit card lock/unlock in the app; enhanced transaction details; $0 fraud liability when reported in a timely manner.
products.fdic_note: FDIC-insured up to allowable limits. Capital One states that any Capital One or Discover Bank deposit accounts opened on or after 2025-05-18 are counted together for FDIC coverage.
products.opening_rules: Open online or in the app in about 5 minutes; name, DOB, address, email, phone, employment, income, SSN/ITIN and citizenship information required; 60 days to fund after approval.
flags: APY renders as 'NaN' in the public HTML — left blank.

products.apy_note: No APY appears on the Citizens savings page (rates are disclosed in account documents / at application). Not recorded.
products.min_open_note: No minimum deposit to open ('You may open a Citizens savings account with any amount').
products.fee_note: $4.99 monthly maintenance fee; waived with one deposit of any amount per statement period OR a $200 minimum daily balance. New accounts get the first 4 monthly fees waived.
products.withdrawal_note: Citizens states it does not limit transactions, including withdrawals, on savings accounts.
products.app: Yes — Citizens Mobile Banking App (Savings Tracker® goals, Round Ups).
products.opening_rules: Open online, by phone or in a branch. Personal savings accounts are offered only in CT, DC, DE, FL, MD, MA, MI, NH, NJ, NY, OH, PA, RI, VT and VA (Citizens' own statement).
flags: Not a nationwide product: Citizens lists 15 states + DC for personal savings.
APY not published on the product page.

products.apy_note: No APY on the Fifth Third savings page; the bank directs customers to a branch or banker for promotional rates. Not recorded.
products.fee_note: $7.50 monthly maintenance fee; $0 with a Fifth Third checking account or an account balance of $500 or greater.
products.fdic_note: Fifth Third Bank, N.A. is FDIC-insured (certificate 6672).
products.opening_rules: Open online or in a branch; $0 minimum opening deposit.
flags: APY not published publicly; bank says promotional rates are available in branch or by phone.

tiers.condition: Relationship APY — requires a linked, open HSBC Premier checking account and monthly qualifying activity

products.apy_note: Standard APY 0.05% and Relationship APY 3.10% (minimum balance $1). The Relationship APY applies automatically for the rest of the opening month plus 3 months, then requires at least one qualifying criterion each month ($500 card spend, $500 card payments, $5,000 direct deposits, an HSBC-serviced mortgage, or Premier Elite status). No 'as of' date is shown on the page.
products.app: Yes — HSBC mobile and online banking (including international transfers).
products.fdic_note: FDIC insured to the maximum permitted by law.
products.opening_rules: Must be an HSBC Premier client with a new or existing HSBC Premier checking account; applicant must be 18+ and provide funding account details for an external transfer.
flags: HSBC shows no rate effective date.
3.10% requires a Premier checking relationship plus monthly qualifying activity.

tiers.condition: All balances; no minimum balance required to earn APY

products.apy_note: 3.1% APY, 'correct as of 10/21/26'; no minimum balance required to open an account or earn APY; rate is variable.
products.min_open_note: No minimum balance required to open.
products.fee_note: No monthly maintenance fees; interest compounded daily; 10 withdrawals/transfers per statement cycle (no fee for exceeding, but repeated excess may close the account).
products.withdrawal_note: 10 withdrawals/transfers per statement cycle (combined limited transactions).
products.app: Yes — Ally online and mobile banking (the bank's security guarantee explicitly covers 'Online or Mobile Banking' transactions).
products.security: Online and mobile security guarantee: no liability for unauthorized online/mobile transactions reported within 60 days; multi-factor authentication; fraud monitoring.

tiers.condition: All balances; no minimum balance for the APY

products.apy_note: 3.20% APY, accurate as of 2026-10-21; no minimum balance to open, avoid a fee, or obtain the APY; rate is variable.
products.min_open_note: No minimum balance required to open.
products.fee_note: No monthly fees and no minimum balance.
products.app: Yes — Amex App: manage the High Yield Savings Account, deposit funds, set alerts (per Amex's app page).
products.security: Two-step verification with verification codes or app notifications; biometrics; passkeys; SafeKey; Voice ID; fraud alerts; device management.
products.fdic_note: Each depositor is insured to at least $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category.
products.opening_rules: Apply online in minutes; fund by linking an external bank account or mailing a check; identity verification required.

products.apy_note: 3.50% APY, 'Annual percentage yield as of October 21, 2026'; APY may change at any time; no fees and no minimum deposit; no limit on withdrawals/transfers.
products.min_open_note: No minimum deposit and no credit check.
products.fee_note: No fees; no minimum deposit; same-day transfers up to $100,000 to/from other banks when requested by the cut-off.
products.withdrawal_note: No limit to the number of withdrawals or transfers (Marcus FAQ).
products.app: Yes — Marcus app (open an account, schedule transfers).
products.fdic_note: Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Member FDIC.
products.bonus: 3-month promotional APY increase of 1.00% on top of the standard APY (Marcus states that with one referral in a year and an unchanged standard APY, the combined APY would be 3.75%).
products.opening_rules: Open online or in the Marcus app; no minimum deposit and no credit check.
flags: The 1.00% promotional increase is tied to the referral programme and lasts 3 months — it is not a standing base rate.

tiers.condition: Standard savings APY, no direct deposit
With eligible direct deposit: 1.10% boost for up to 6 months, then the then-current standard APY

products.apy_note: Savings APY 3.30% as of 2026-10-20; up to 4.40% with a 1.10% boost for up to 6 months when eligible direct deposit is set up (open the account by 2026-12-31 and set up direct deposit within 60 days). Rates are variable.
products.fee_note: No monthly, overdraft or minimum-balance fees.
products.app: Yes — SoFi app (mobile check deposit, Vaults, roundups).
products.security: Continuous account monitoring for suspicious activity; customizable alerts; FDIC insurance through a network of participating banks up to $3M (SoFi's own claim).
products.fdic_note: SoFi Bank, N.A. Member FDIC; additional coverage up to $3M through a network of participating banks (SoFi's own statement — verify with SoFi before relying on it).
products.bonus: $50 or $400 cash bonus with eligible direct deposit of $1,000+ (terms apply).
products.opening_rules: Open online; SoFi Bank automatically opens a SoFi Checking account alongside the savings account; eligible direct deposit required for the APY boost and the cash bonus.
flags: The 4.40% headline depends on a 6-month promotional boost tied to direct deposit; it is not a 12-month rate.
The $3M FDIC claim is SoFi's own marketing statement, not an FDIC publication.

products.apy_note: Tiered APY: 3.50% below $250,000; 3.65% from $250,000 to $1,000,000. 'This information is accurate as of 10/07/2026.' No monthly maintenance fees and no minimum balance to open; maximum $1,000,000 per account.
products.fee_note: No monthly maintenance fees. Maximum deposit $1,000,000 per Tiered Savings account; up to 3 accounts per customer; accounts at a zero balance for 6 months close automatically.
products.security: Secure 24/7 online access; check deposit by image; FDIC insurance up to the maximum allowed by law.
products.fdic_note: Barclays deposits are insured up to the maximum allowed by law (Barclays Bank Delaware, certificate 57203).
products.bonus: $200 bonus: be a new Barclays Tiered Savings customer, open through 2026-10-31, fund with at least $25,000 within 30 days and keep a $25,000 balance for 120 consecutive days; bonus paid about 60 days later.
products.opening_rules: Open online as a new Barclays savings customer; no minimum to open.

products.bank: First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company (CIT Bank division)
products.apy_note: 3.75% APY on balances of $5,000 or more; 0.25% APY below $5,000. CIT's rate sheet and the product page state APYs are accurate as of 2026-07-01; minimum to open $100; no monthly service fees.
products.fee_note: No account opening or monthly service fees.
products.app: Yes — CIT Bank mobile app (mobile check deposit, account management).
products.security: Continuous fraud monitoring (CIT's own statement); FDIC insurance.
products.fdic_note: CIT Bank is a division of First Citizens Bank; deposits are insured up to $250,000 per depositor per ownership category and are combined with all First Citizens divisions for coverage.
products.bonus: APY Boost: promo code BOOST50 adds 0.50% APY for 6 months (4.25% APY on balances of $5,000+ during the boost). Promotion runs 2026-09-29 to 2026-12-15.
products.opening_rules: Open online in about five minutes with address, phone, email and SSN/ITIN; fund with at least $100.
flags: CIT's published rate sheet is effective 2026-07-01 — older than the other verified quotes (2026-10-07 to 2026-10-21). Confirm at application.
CIT accounts are aggregated with First Citizens Bank for FDIC coverage; they do not add separate $250k capacity.

products.bank: Discover Bank (inactive) — now Capital One, N.A.
products.apy_note: Discover Bank's FDIC record shows ACTIVE = 0 (inactive) in the FDIC institution data. Discover savings deposits sit with Capital One, N.A. for insurance purposes, so there is no separate Discover $250k capacity.
products.fdic_note: Discover Bank (cert 5649) is listed as inactive by the FDIC; Capital One states accounts opened on/after 2025-05-18 are counted together with Capital One deposit accounts for FDIC coverage.
flags: Included only to record the merger: Discover is not a separate FDIC-insured institution anymore.
